name: The Inheritance of Crimson Manor: Victorian Edition
summary:
Victorian Edition – The Inheritance of Crimson Manor
Delve deeper into the eerie and enigmatic world of The Inheritance of Crimson Manor with the Victorian Edition Bundle, an essential collection for fans of gothic mystery and suspense.

This bundle includes:

️ Penny Dreadful DLC – Discover a new chapter in the Crimson Manor universe with an official illustrated story, inspired by the Penny Dreadfuls of the 1890s. This visual tale unveils events that preceded the main story, revealing secrets of the mansion’s past and enhancing your understanding of its sinister legacy. (Installed as a PDF in the game directory: DLC/PennyDreadful/)

Original Soundtrack – Immerse yourself in the haunting ambiance of Crimson Manor with a meticulously crafted soundtrack by Daniel Alvarez Veroy. Each track captures the dark, unsettling, and mysterious essence of the mansion, drawing you further into its foreboding world.

Expand your journey into the mystery of Crimson Manor—if you dare.
